scope: mainline 0.7 nm nonseparable Maxwell; G00=F3, G10=Gx560, G01=Gz528, G11=F5
solver_identity_note: Solver SHAs below are the original producing commits. Analysis commits are recorded separately and never replace solver identity.

coordinates_and_phase.union_method: exact duplicate nodes only; 1e-12 nm tolerance is diagnostic and is not used to merge distinct nodes
coordinates_and_phase.modal_boundary_phase: exp(i*k_z*z_boundary); z_boundary is physical_z_max for top modes and physical_z_min for bottom modes; use saved outgoing_amplitude_at_boundary without phase fitting or shifting

background_and_field_recovery.curl_source: direct UFL curl(E_FE) into DG6 for all four saved fields
background_and_field_recovery.scaled_curl_definition: curl(E_scattered)/k0; subtract the layered_fresnel background curl from the direct saved-field curl(E_total), then divide by k0
background_and_field_recovery.unknown_recovery: restore_p6_total_field(label, cfg, saved_vector) reconstructs the saved complex128 full p6 coefficient vector into the matching p6 function space; no solve, p4 factor, or phase adjustment is performed during recovery.
background_and_field_recovery.local_p6_partition: each hexahedral p6 element has local tensor dimension 882, with 450 interior and 432 trace degrees of freedom; p4 interface retains 340 ordered modal carrier rows

solver_gate.residual_definition: ||A6 x - b6||_2 / ||b6||_2, explicit full-system true residual, checked after solve release
